title: Hacienda Buena Vista Manor House

buildingCutout.basis: The native manor outline is identified by the HAER site plan and adjacent mapped service row.

terrainReference.basis: Independent ground at the west warehouse approach from the working court.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap way 530758886 identifies the envelope by position. The HAER PR-4 site plan and the National Register survey identify the manor east of the working court, with the formal garden beyond and the long service row immediately south.
mapIdentity.scope: Native way 530758886 fixes the manor envelope; HAER PR-4 sheets 4 and 13 through 15 confirm the site identity, west storage base, wraparound veranda, east masonry wing and open upper courtyard. One exact November 2023 CC0 Qualla photograph fixes the photographed western massing and red corrugated roofing.

note: Model zero is the independent west warehouse approach. The 9-foot storage base and west living-floor section follow HAER. The documented garden entry remains near the upper floor. The coarse source DEM tilts across the west facade, so thresholds and the historic hardscape registration remain approximate.
